header: Three weeks from signed contract to first value
subheadline: Kickoff, configuration, go-live: the three weeks a Brightpath Growth customer walks through, with the same milestones and due dates visible in their own portal from day one. Median across 1,340 companies is 17 days.

slides.title: Week one: kickoff and data
slides.lead: One 45-minute call, one agreed go-live date, one named owner on each side.
slides.description: The journey opens with the customer's data import and the three decisions that block everything else: who signs off, which systems connect, and what go-live actually means for them.

slides.title: Week two: configuration
slides.lead: Your team configures while the customer clears their own open tasks.
slides.description: Every open question sits in the customer's task list with a due date and an automatic reminder, so nobody spends Friday afternoon chasing a missing tax ID by email.

slides.title: Week three: go-live and handover
slides.lead: The account moves to your support team with its full history attached.
slides.description: Go-live closes the journey, exports the timeline and hands the account over with every decision recorded. Support opens its first ticket already knowing what was agreed in week one.
